title: Passing jobs to other bands and charging more for parades
summary: He had more work than he could play, gave jobs to others, and charged groups more than other leaders for parades and funerals.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Oh, I know. I know. So, and so, well, we played, we had more work than we could play. We had enough work to give three and four bands. We'd give them, give them job. I had to give Howard job. Oh, so many fellas, you know. And the same, you see the same fella played trumpet with the E. Rekker band there. Pazio.

Every time me and him would talk, he said, what's the matter, kid, you don't get no more parade? He said, man, I like to play your job. You pay good. I like to get more money than what they get. And, and, and, and, well, they just begin to get a little bit more money now. But I used to get more money than they get. I'd be just getting three dollars, two dollars, something like that. I don't know what they was getting. I used to get more than that for them all the time, you know what I mean? And sometimes I ring them out to them, I tell them, I said, I said, Ray, I got a parade, I got a funeral for you. I got a parade for you. I said, how much are you? Oh, someone, someone. I said, man, I tell him straight. I said, man, I can get more. Oh, he told me straight. Oh, man, don't overdo this thing. I said, man, I'm telling you the truth. He said, you know, a lot of them fellas, you take a lot of people in Moreira, the boys in Moreira, you know, like all the boys raised up together, like somebody die or something. Well, they would go around and pick up money, Mr. Bill, regardless how many organizations it be belongs to, but they just pick up the money, give them, give the fella a ban, you know what I mean? Well, they pick them money up, well, I know they going to pick that money up, it's just as cheap, I charge them. Because I know they ain't going to take that money out, but left they going to drink it up. You know what I mean? So I try to get as much as I can, you know what I mean? So, well. Did you ever have any manager or just did your own booking? I had no manager, never had no manager, but that white boy.
